title: Pure Evol
summary: Pure Evol build uniting FIRE Reptile Evoltiles, FIRE Dinosaur Evolsaurs, and Dragon Evolzar Xyz Monsters with generic staples. The Evoltiles Tribute or flip themselves to Special Summon Evolsaurs from the Deck—unlocking their bonus effects—before overlaying into Rank 4 and Rank 6 Evolzar negates.

summary.title: Starters
points: Evolsaur Lios Sets Evolutionary Bridge or Evo-Singularity directly from the Deck on Normal or Special Summon, then sends a FIRE Reptile or Dinosaur from the Deck to the GY to make two monsters' Types and Levels match.

Evoltile Pholis Special Summons itself from the hand to flip a monster face-down (or flips an Evoltile face-down), Sets Evo-Force or Evo-Instant directly from the Deck, and treatsEvolsaurs summoned while it is on the field as if Special Summoned by an Evoltile.
Evo-Diversity searches any Evoltile or Evolsaur monster from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Evolsaur Lios (One-Card Evolzar Lars)
steps: Normal Summon Evolsaur Lios and use its trigger effect to Set Evo-Singularity directly from the Deck.
Activate Lios's second effect to send Evoltile Megachirella (or Evolsaur Terias) from the Deck to the GY, matching Lios's Level and Type with another monster or preparing Evo-Singularity in the GY.

With Evoltile Pholis or Evo-Force, Tribute Evoltile Najasho on the field to Special Summon two Evolsaurs from the Deck (such as Evolsaur Vulcano reviving another Evolsaur, or Level 6 Evolsaur Elias summoning Evolsaur Terias from the hand).

Overlay two Level 4 Dinosaurs into Evolzar Dolkka or Evolzar Laggia, or two Level 6 monsters into Evolzar Lars, and flip Evo-Singularity to Xyz Summon a second Evolzar by attaching an Evoltile and Evolsaur from your GY.

summary.title: Evoltile-to-Evolsaur Evolution
summary.text: Evolsaur monsters only gain their on-summon effects when Special Summoned by the effect of an Evoltile monster (or a card like Evo-Force that treats the summon as by an Evoltile): Evolsaur Vulcano revives an Evolsaur from the GY for an instant Rank 4, Evolsaur Diplo destroys an opponent's Spell or Trap, Evolsaur Cerato gains 200 ATK and searches an Evoltile when it destroys a monster by battle, and Level 6 Evolsaur Elias Special Summons a Level 6 or lower FIRE Dinosaur from the hand for Rank 6 plays. Evoltile Najasho summons an Evolsaur when Tributed on the field, while Evoltile Westlo and Evoltile Lagosucho summon from the Deck when flipped.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Evolzar Lars (Rank 6) cannot be targeted by opponent's monster effects while it has material, and detaches 1 material (only 1 if it has Reptile/Dinosaur materials) in response to an opponent's activation to negate the effects of any face-up card your opponent controls.
Evolzar Laggia (Rank 4) detaches 2 materials to negate a Spell/Trap activation or a monster Normal/Special Summon, functioning as a Solemn Judgment on legs.

Evolzar Dolkka (Rank 4) detaches 1 material to negate and destroy a monster effect activation (not once per turn), and Evolzar Solda (Rank 6) detaches 1 material to destroy any monster the opponent Special Summons while being indestructible by card effects while it has material.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Evo-Force Tributes an Evoltile to Special Summon an Evolsaur from the Deck as if summoned by an Evoltile (triggering both Najasho and the Evolsaur).
Evo-Singularity Special Summons an Evolzar Xyz Monster straight from the Extra Deck and attaches 1 Evoltile and 1 Evolsaur from your GY to it as Xyz Material.

Evo-Karma prevents the opponent from activating cards or effects when you Normal or Special Summon a monster with an Evoltile's effect, while Evo-Instant and Evolutionary Bridge provide additional Evoltile Tributes and battle redirection.
